metric_choice_timing: post hoc after original DROID and external MSE findings; secondary only

policy.aggregation: mean windows within episode; equal episodes; equal training seeds

bootstrap.interval: 95% percentile interval for method-minus-reference absolute error
bootstrap.multiplicity: secondary exploratory intervals, unadjusted; correlated horizons and metrics
bootstrap.units: recording sessions crossed with training seeds; paired across methods

policy.metric_precision: FP32 errors; FP64 stored values and aggregation
policy.prediction_precision: float32; autocast disabled; CUDA matmul/cudnn TF32 disabled
policy.restrictions: No training, reselection, test access, RGB decoding, control-success or SOTA inference.
policy.target: raw frozen DINOv2-small native 4x4 features, 6144 coordinates
